scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is proved from Stewart's odd almost-practical criterion and closure theorem, as reproduced in an inspected full-text source. Direct full-text access to the 1954 article was unavailable, leaving a residual originality risk that an equivalent corollary appears there under different notation. Finite computations only corroborate base cases and a bounded grid; they are not used as an infinite proof.
title: Three-prime-support classification of odd almost practical numbers
